document.name: NY Kids Club 22nd Street Classes
document.shortDescription: Weekday and weekend enrichment classes in Flatiron for babies, toddlers, and preschoolers.
document.longDescription:
NY Kids Club's official Winter/Spring 2026 22nd Street schedule PDF lists enrichment classes at 38 E 22nd Street in Flatiron with contact phone (917) 525-4559 and email nykidsclub22@nypreschoolandkidsclub.com. The published schedule includes baby and toddler programs such as Musical Tots, baby art and STEM, and toddler science.

The official schedule snippet shows weekday classes including toddler science at 4:15 PM and also shows weekend programming, supporting weekday, weekend, morning, afternoon, and after-school timing tags. This listing follows the same NY Kids Club enrichment convention already used elsewhere in the catalog for early childhood art, music, STEM, and gym-oriented classes.

Sources: https://nypreschoolandkidsclub.com/22nd-street/ https://nypreschoolandkidsclub.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/03/22nd-Street-%E2%80%93-Winter_Spring-Enrichment-Table-Schedule-3.pdf https://dev.nykidsclub.com/wp-content/themes/nykids/images/nykidsclub_logo.jpg
